title: Fake Office Lease Notice
scenario: A landlord-like email says office rent must be paid to a new account.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.C: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: Fake Office Lease Notice: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Lease payment changes require verified landlord/legal confirmation.
